en: Tinted vintage image of a large steel railway truss bridge with several arch spans crossing a wide river. Low green banks and a few distant buildings appear on the horizon. A small boat is visible in the foreground right. The word "Nijmegen" is printed in red in the upper right corner, "Spoorbrug" (railway bridge) is printed at the bottom center, and along the left edge in red is the publisher credit "Uitg: J. H. Schaefer, Amsterdam" followed by the number "1507".
